# Llama or Alpaca?

> A free, fast photo guessing game: look at a real photo and decide — llama or alpaca? Build streaks, learn the tells (ears, size, face, fleece), and beat your best score. Made by Steven J. Hubbard.

## Pages

- [Play the game](https://www.llamaoralpaca.com/): The guessing game — real photos, streaks, and scores.
- [Llama vs Alpaca: How to Tell the Difference](https://www.llamaoralpaca.com/llama-vs-alpaca): The four tells — ears, size, face, fleece — plus fun facts and FAQs about both animals.

## Merchandise

- [Llama or Alpaca merch shop](https://llama-or-alpaca.myspreadshop.com/): T-shirts, hoodies, and gifts for llama and alpaca lovers.
